scope: Read complete packager and synthetic tests; no production inventory, archive, model or policy execution.
Checked actual immutable baseline-review and first-baseline manifest schemas, previous failed-attempt cleanup schema, current routing package schema, finalizer and private-stream producer contracts.

Complete mode requires all four terminal strict final audits, fixed 1024-update/32768-trial counters, both full 16-context endpoints, checkpoint/raw hashes and verified instance/disk absence; failure-evidence mode retains incomplete flags.

Archives retain full worker trees, failed prior attempts, immutable baseline prefixes, once-only reference data, report and exact source dependencies, with the separately pinned 49-file input asset as prerequisite.

Path traversal, symlink/credential checks, exact member hashes, deterministic gzip/tar, no-overwrite and 2-GiB rejection are covered. Final private generator snapshots are compared directly with all four checkpoints.
qualification: Production completeness and final schemas will be validated only after completed owner audits and cleanup.
Failure-evidence mode still requires all four previously completed baseline records; it is appropriate to the current launched cohort, not a general pre-baseline launch-failure packager.
Finalizer updates terminal routing before the final stream comparison, so its routing hash is stable for packaging.
